## EP09 -- cap sheet (ep09_caps Data Table)

max_drafts_per_run 5 - max_drafts_per_day 50 - llm_calls_per_day 50 - kill_enabled true - breaker_tripped false - consecutive_errors 0 - error_trip_threshold 3.

Guard: cap reads this BEFORE the model is called and throws (not skips) on kill/trip/budget. Bump caps writes llm_calls_today +1 after every successful draft.

## THERE IS NO SEND NODE

Every draft is read by a human before anything leaves. This matches the estate rule: autosend RULED NO 2026-09-21 (memory hq-followup-autosend-engine). Schema gate rejects any draft over 120 words or carrying a URL not present in the source lead row -- see README REFUTE-FIRST.
